reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model SE4570, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The label's date code is 08/23, which is outside the recalled date codes of 07/22 NH and 08/22 NH. The FAQ states that a date code outside these is not part of the recall.
The serial number check was skipped because the program has no serial rule, so it does not affect the outcome.
The purchase is from a listed retailer (www.justinboots.com) on 2022-11-24, inside the sale window, and no receipt is required. Purchase does not change the outcome.
No other claims share a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this claim, so there is no flag.
